messages:
maria.k: Hey team — just accepted an org invite and I can see the project but the Billing tab shows a 403. Others on my team can view billing. Can someone help? :confused:
support-bot: Thanks for reporting, maria.k. Can you paste the console URL + last 4 of org id? Also did you accept via SSO or email invite?
maria.k: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/0xABC123/projects/finops
org id ends with ABC123
Accepted via Okta SSO
devon: @maria.k can you try incognito and confirm same 403? Also can you run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -I https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/0xABC123/projects/finops/billing` and paste response headers (mask tokens)
maria.k: incognito same 403. cURL returned `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` plus header `x-rw-perm-reason: role-not-found`
lisa: x-rw-perm-reason: role-not-found means console couldn't map the user's org role to billing role. Did your Okta group-to-role mapping include the Billing role on the new org? :thinking:
zack: We saw a race in last night's org-merge job where SCIM group sync completed after role propagation; group membership created but rolebinding propagation job skipped for some members. If `billing-admin` is granted via group, user will be missing transiently.
maria.k: that lines up — I joined 20m after the merge
devon: quick repro steps for infra to confirm: 1) create org merge between orgA and orgB 2) accept invite via SSO 3) trigger scim sync, kill role-propagation worker mid-sync 4) attempt billing page -> 403
oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 runbook link: https://go.redwood/incs/2026-042
zack: workaround: add the user directly to project billing role via console or CLI: `rwctl projects grant-role --project finops --user maria.k --role billing:viewer` then refresh. We're rolling a fix to retry propagation for orphaned bindings.
maria.k: Grant worked, can view billing now. Thanks :relieved:
devon: We'll follow up with a postmortem and push a migration to detect orphaned rolebindings during org-merge. Assigned to devon + zack. ETA for hotfix ~2h.
lisa: If anyone else hits this, run `rwctl org check-role-bindings --org 0xABC123 --fix` to detect and queue fixes.
maria.k: adding logs below:
```
2026-03-16T22:41:12Z [org-merge] merged orgB->orgA
2026-03-16T22:41:36Z [scim-sync] queued group members for orgA
2026-03-16T22:42:05Z [role-prop] worker-3 panicked: runtime/oom
2026-03-16T22:42:06Z [role-prop] completed 0/1200 members
```
